question: Which option correctly shows the path that the sperms take when they are released from the human male reproductive system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct path that sperms take when they are released from the human male reproductive system is **Testis → Vas deferens → Urethra → Penis**.
 
• The **testis** is where sperms are produced.
 
• The **vas deferens** transports mature sperm from the testis to the urethra.
 
• The **urethra** serves as the final duct through which the sperms are ejaculated out of the penis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **ureter** is not part of the path that sperms take; it is a duct that conducts urine from the kidneys to the bladder.
 
• The **penis** is the external organ through which the sperms are finally released.
 
• The male reproductive system also includes accessory glands like the seminal vesicles, prostate gland, and bulbourethral glands, which add fluids to the sperm to create semen.
 
• During ejaculation, muscular contractions propel the sperm through the vas deferens and urethra and out of the body.
